verdict.rationale: stagewise's docs describe bring-your-own-key access to Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM and MiniMax. They also cover self-hosted models via Ollama, LM Studio and OpenAI-compatible endpoints, plus a managed library of pre-configured models. Each parallel agent has its own chat session and can use a different model, so model choice is per session. The free Hobby tier is limited to 3 standard models. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of per-session model switching across providers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: Already paying for Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, or MiniMax? Bring your existing API keys and use them directly in stagewise.
Each agent has its own chat session and can use a different model.
Access a large library of pre-configured models through the managed inference service.
